OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Santa Praxedes
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable.

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Bayombong due to rainfall of 22.4 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.

HARVEST ADVISORY — Bayombong
Rainfall of 22.4 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.

4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
